en.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow: <yellow Thorn, Osteo Striga, Touch of Malice, Cull's Shadow, and Necrochasm. />

Melee Hits apply Potent Corruption, which deals Kinetic damage. Defeated enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 meter radius.

Kills with the following also spread the Potent Corruption:
• Thorn's Bullets
• Osteo Striga's Corruption Effect
• Touch of Malice's Blight's Corruption Effect
• Necrochasm's Corruption and Cursed Thrall Explosions
• Cull's Shadow Corruption Effect

Potent Corruption ticks every <pve 0.52 /> <pvp [0.7] /> seconds for a total of <pve 19 /> <pvp [?] /> ticks over <pve 10 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds. Deals a total of <pve 1366 /> <pvp [?] /> damage over the entire duration.

Corruption's first tick deals <pve 32.35 /> <pvp [5?] /> damage.

Exclusive to 'Potent Corruption': DoT ramps up every tick, with the damage increases compounding together. For the first 14 ticks, each tick deals 11% more damage than the last. For the last 5 ticks, the damage increases by an average of 41% per tick.
